description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'BuyFullKit' that provides a UI for purchasing a full template kit. It includes image carousels, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and a link to an external purchase URL.

classes.name: BuyFullKit
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a carousel of images and buttons for purchasing a full template kit.

classes.name: _BuyFullKitState
classes.description: State class managing the carousel, copy-to-clipboard, and purchase logic for 'BuyFullKit'.

methods.name: buyLink
methods.description: Asynchronously launches an external URL for purchasing the kit.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the page controller and starts the auto-scroll timer.

methods.name: _startAutoScroll
methods.description: Sets up periodic timer to automatically change images in the carousel.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer and disposes of the page controller.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including image carousel and purchase buttons.
